description: Image Description: The image depicts two giraffes in an outdoor enclosure, likely within a zoo or wildlife park. Both giraffes are standing close to each other and are reaching up to feed from a tall, elevated feeding station. The feeding station consists of a metal pole supporting a basket-like structure, which is covered by a thatched roof made of dried grass or straw, providing shade. The giraffes have the characteristic long necks, spotted coats with a pattern of irregular brown patches separated
